title: Picadinho (Brazilian beef stew) with rice and pumpkin
steps: Cut the beef into small cubes and chop the onion, garlic and tomatoes.
Sear the beef in the oil in batches, add the onion and garlic and fry for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, paprika and stock and braise covered for 30 minutes.
Dice the pumpkin, add it and braise for 10 more minutes; cook the rice according to the packet.
Season with salt, pepper and parsley and serve with rice.
